1.headline: Nvidia Brings Back Its Old Boss
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
A famous boss is back at his old job.
Nvidia is a big American company. It makes computer chips for AI. On Monday, Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang. He is the top boss again.
Huang was away from the job for a while. The company was checking a security problem. People said another country tried to use him. The check is still going on.
The company's leaders all voted yes. They said Huang is the right person. They also talked with the United States government. They said his return is safe.
Why is this big news? Nvidia chips run many AI tools. People all over the world use them.
Again, Jensen Huang is the boss of Nvidia again.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.
유명한 사장이 원래 자리로 돌아왔습니다.
엔비디아는 미국의 큰 회사입니다. AI용 컴퓨터 칩을 만듭니다. 월요일, 엔비디아는 젠슨 황을 다시 데려왔습니다. 그는 다시 최고 책임자가 되었습니다.
황은 한동안 자리를 떠나 있었습니다. 회사는 보안 문제를 조사하고 있었습니다. 다른 나라가 그를 이용하려 했다는 말이 있었습니다. 조사는 아직 진행 중입니다.
회사 이사들은 모두 찬성표를 던졌습니다. 그들은 황이 적임자라고 말했습니다. 그들은 미국 정부와도 이야기했습니다. 그의 복귀가 안전하다고 말했습니다.
왜 큰 뉴스일까요? 엔비디아 칩은 많은 AI 도구를 돌립니다. 전 세계 사람들이 그것을 씁니다.
다시 말해, 젠슨 황이 다시 엔비디아의 사장이 되었습니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

2.headline: Nvidia Brings Back Jensen Huang as CEO
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
What happens when the world's most famous chip company calls its old leader back?

Nvidia makes powerful computer chips for artificial intelligence, or AI. On Monday, November 23, the company brought back Jensen Huang as its CEO. A CEO is the top boss of a company. Huang also returned to the company's board. The board is the group that guides the company.
The board said every member voted for his return. Board chair Harvey Jones said Huang is the right person to lead Nvidia.

Why was Huang away? The board had started an investigation. Reports said he was the target of a foreign spy effort. While he was away, finance chief Colette Kress ran the company for a while. Nvidia says the investigation will continue, and Huang supports it. The company also said it spoke with top United States government officials. After that, the board said his return is not a risk to national security.
Why does this matter? Nvidia chips power many AI tools around the world. So many investors watch the company very closely.
To sum up, Jensen Huang is back as the head of Nvidia, but the investigation is still going on.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.
세계에서 가장 유명한 반도체 회사가 예전 리더를 다시 불러들이면 어떻게 될까요?
엔비디아는 인공지능, 즉 AI를 위한 강력한 컴퓨터 칩을 만듭니다. 11월 23일 월요일, 회사는 젠슨 황을 다시 CEO로 데려왔습니다. CEO는 회사의 최고 책임자입니다. 황은 회사 이사회에도 복귀했습니다. 이사회는 회사를 이끄는 사람들의 모임입니다.
이사회는 모든 이사가 그의 복귀에 찬성했다고 밝혔습니다. 하비 존스 이사회 의장은 황이 엔비디아를 이끌 적임자라고 말했습니다.

황은 왜 자리를 비웠을까요? 이사회는 조사를 시작했었습니다. 그가 외국 첩보 활동의 표적이었다는 보도가 있었습니다. 그가 없는 동안에는 재무 책임자 콜레트 크레스가 한동안 회사를 운영했습니다. 엔비디아는 조사가 계속될 것이며, 황도 이를 지지한다고 밝혔습니다. 회사는 미국 정부 고위 관리들과도 이야기했다고 밝혔습니다. 그 뒤 이사회는 그의 복귀가 국가 안보에 위험이 되지 않는다고 말했습니다.
왜 중요할까요? 엔비디아 칩은 전 세계 많은 AI 도구를 움직입니다. 그래서 많은 투자자들이 이 회사를 아주 자세히 지켜봅니다.
정리하면, 젠슨 황이 엔비디아의 수장으로 돌아왔지만, 조사는 아직 진행 중입니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Nvidia Brings Back Jensen Huang as CEO
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
What happens when the world's most famous chip company suddenly calls its old leader back?

Nvidia, the American company that makes powerful chips for artificial intelligence, has brought back Jensen Huang as its chief executive. A chief executive, or CEO, is the top boss of a company. Nvidia announced the news on Monday, November 23, and said the decision takes effect immediately. Huang also returns to the company's board, the group of people that guides the company.

According to the company, the board voted unanimously. That means every member agreed. Board chair Harvey Jones said the board believes Huang is the right person to lead Nvidia. He added that the decision is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers.

So why was Huang away? Earlier, the board set up a committee to investigate reports that he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. In simple words, people from another country may have tried to get secrets through him. While he was away, finance chief Colette Kress served as interim, or temporary, CEO. Nvidia says the investigation will continue until the end, and Huang supports it. The company also said it received input from senior officials in the United States government. Based on that input, the board said it is confident his return poses no risk to national security.

Why does this matter? Nvidia's chips power many AI tools, from chatbots to huge data centers. When its leadership changes, investors and tech companies around the world pay attention. Nvidia also created a new committee to focus on national security and export rules.
To sum up, Jensen Huang is once again running Nvidia, but the security investigation is still going on.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.
세계에서 가장 유명한 반도체 회사가 갑자기 예전 리더를 다시 불러들이면 어떻게 될까요?
인공지능용 강력한 칩을 만드는 미국 회사 엔비디아가 젠슨 황을 최고경영자로 다시 데려왔습니다. 최고경영자, 즉 CEO는 회사의 최고 책임자입니다. 엔비디아는 11월 23일 월요일 이 소식을 발표하며 결정이 즉시 효력을 갖는다고 밝혔습니다. 황은 회사를 이끄는 사람들의 모임인 이사회에도 복귀합니다.
회사에 따르면 이사회는 만장일치로 표결했습니다. 모든 이사가 찬성했다는 뜻입니다. 하비 존스 이사회 의장은 이사회가 황이 엔비디아를 이끌 적임자라고 믿는다고 말했습니다. 그는 이 결정이 주주, 직원, 협력사, 고객에게 가장 이익이 된다고 덧붙였습니다.

그렇다면 황은 왜 자리를 비웠을까요? 앞서 이사회는 그가 외국 정보 활동의 표적이었다는 보도를 조사하기 위해 위원회를 만들었습니다. 쉽게 말해, 다른 나라 사람들이 그를 통해 비밀을 얻으려 했을 수 있다는 것입니다. 그가 없는 동안에는 재무 책임자 콜레트 크레스가 임시 CEO를 맡았습니다. 엔비디아는 조사가 끝까지 계속될 것이며 황도 이를 지지한다고 밝혔습니다. 회사는 또 미국 정부 고위 관리들의 의견을 들었다고 했습니다. 이사회는 그 의견을 바탕으로 그의 복귀가 국가 안보에 위험이 되지 않는다고 확신한다고 밝혔습니다.
왜 중요할까요? 엔비디아의 칩은 챗봇부터 거대한 데이터 센터까지 많은 AI 도구를 움직입니다. 이 회사의 경영진이 바뀌면 전 세계 투자자와 기술 기업들이 주목합니다. 엔비디아는 국가 안보와 수출 규정에 집중하는 새 위원회도 만들었습니다.
정리하면, 젠슨 황이 다시 엔비디아를 이끌게 되었지만 보안 조사는 아직 진행 중입니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

4.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as Chief Executive
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
The man most closely associated with the AI chip boom is back in charge.

Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive, effective immediately, the company announced on Monday, November 23. Huang is also returning to the board of directors. According to Nvidia, the board reached its decision unanimously after a series of discussions and meetings with Huang, and said it was satisfied with his candor and his ability to lead.

Board chair Harvey Jones said directors believe Huang is the right person to run the company and that bringing him back serves the best interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers. Chief financial officer Colette Kress, who had stepped in as interim CEO, will continue in her finance role, and the board publicly thanked her.

The leadership change followed an inquiry by a committee of independent directors into reports that Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. Nvidia says that investigation, handled by outside lawyers, will proceed to its conclusion and that Huang supports it. The company also said it had received input from senior levels of the US government, and that, based on that input, it is confident his reinstatement poses no national security risk.

In addition, the board has formed a new committee on national security and export controls, launched a search for a new chief compliance officer, and pledged to keep cooperating with government investigations.

The stakes are high. Nvidia supplies much of the hardware behind today's AI systems, and its decisions ripple through global technology supply chains and stock markets. Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993, has long been seen as central to its strategy.
To sum up, Nvidia has restored Jensen Huang to the top job, while the probe that led to his departure continues.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
AI 반도체 붐과 가장 밀접하게 연결된 인물이 다시 경영을 맡게 되었습니다.
엔비디아 이사회가 젠슨 황을 사장 겸 최고경영자로 즉시 복귀시켰다고 회사가 11월 23일 월요일 발표했습니다. 황은 이사회에도 복귀합니다. 엔비디아에 따르면 이사회는 황과 여러 차례 논의와 회의를 거친 뒤 만장일치로 결정했으며, 그의 솔직함과 리더십 능력에 만족한다고 밝혔습니다.
하비 존스 이사회 의장은 이사들이 황이 회사를 운영할 적임자라고 믿으며, 그를 다시 데려오는 것이 주주, 직원, 협력사, 고객에게 가장 이익이 된다고 말했습니다. 임시 CEO를 맡았던 최고재무책임자 콜레트 크레스는 재무 업무를 계속 맡으며, 이사회는 그녀에게 공개적으로 감사를 표했습니다.

이번 경영진 변화는 황이 외국 정보 활동의 표적이었다는 보도에 대해 독립 이사들로 구성된 위원회가 조사를 벌인 뒤 나왔습니다. 엔비디아는 외부 변호사들이 맡은 이 조사가 결론이 날 때까지 진행될 것이며 황도 이를 지지한다고 밝혔습니다. 회사는 또 미국 정부 고위층의 의견을 들었고, 그 의견을 바탕으로 그의 복귀가 국가 안보상 위험이 없다고 확신한다고 밝혔습니다.
이에 더해 이사회는 국가 안보와 수출 통제를 다루는 새 위원회를 만들고, 새 최고준법책임자를 찾기 시작했으며, 정부 조사에 계속 협조하겠다고 약속했습니다.
걸려 있는 것이 큽니다. 엔비디아는 오늘날 AI 시스템을 뒷받침하는 하드웨어의 상당 부분을 공급하며, 그 결정은 전 세계 기술 공급망과 주식 시장에 파급됩니다. 1993년 회사를 공동 창업한 황은 오랫동안 회사 전략의 중심으로 여겨져 왔습니다.
정리하면, 엔비디아가 젠슨 황을 최고 자리에 복귀시켰으며, 그가 자리를 떠나게 된 계기가 된 조사는 계속되고 있습니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

5.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Huang as CEO as Intelligence Probe Continues
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
In a dramatic reversal at the world's most closely watched chipmaker, Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia.

The company announced on Monday, November 23, that its board had reinstated Huang as president and chief executive, and restored his seat on the board, with immediate effect. In a statement, Nvidia said directors reached the decision unanimously following a series of discussions and meetings with Huang, and that they were satisfied with both his candor and his capacity to lead.

Board chair Harvey Jones said the directors are convinced Huang is the right person to steer the company, and that his return is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers. Colette Kress, the chief financial officer who had been minding the store as interim CEO, will remain in her finance post, and the board went out of its way to thank her.

The reinstatement does not draw a line under the affair that prompted his exit. A committee made up solely of independent directors, advised by outside counsel, is still investigating reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation, and Nvidia says that inquiry will run its course with Huang's full backing. Crucially, the company said it had sought input from the senior ranks of the US government and, on that basis, is confident that bringing him back poses no national security risk.

The board is also shoring up its oversight. It has established a dedicated committee on national security and export controls, begun hunting for a new chief compliance officer, and committed to continued cooperation with government investigations.

Why should anyone outside Silicon Valley care? Nvidia's processors sit at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, so turmoil in its executive suite reverberates across global supply chains and financial markets alike. Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993, is widely regarded as the architect of its rise, which goes a long way toward explaining the board's eagerness to have him back.
To sum up, Nvidia has handed the reins back to Jensen Huang, even as the investigation that sidelined him grinds on.
Thank you for listening.

들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

1.headline: Four Countries Will Host the 2031 Women's World Cup
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
One big soccer party will happen in four countries!
FIFA runs world soccer. On Monday, FIFA chose the hosts for the 2031 Women's World Cup. There are four hosts. They are the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica.
This cup will be the biggest ever. Forty-eight teams will play. There will be one hundred and four games. Before, only thirty-two teams played.
Did you know? The United States won the first Women's World Cup in 1991.
It is also the first time four countries share this cup. Fans can travel and see many places.
Again, four countries will host the 2031 Women's World Cup.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.
큰 축구 잔치 하나가 네 나라에서 열립니다!
FIFA는 세계 축구를 운영합니다. 월요일, FIFA는 2031년 여자 월드컵 개최국을 정했습니다. 개최국은 네 곳입니다. 미국, 멕시코, 코스타리카, 자메이카입니다.
이번 대회는 역대 가장 큰 대회가 됩니다. 48개 팀이 경기합니다. 경기는 104번 열립니다. 전에는 32개 팀만 경기했습니다.
알고 계셨나요? 미국은 1991년 첫 여자 월드컵에서 우승했습니다.
네 나라가 이 대회를 함께 여는 것도 처음입니다. 팬들은 여행하며 여러 곳을 볼 수 있습니다.
다시 말해, 네 나라가 2031년 여자 월드컵을 엽니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

2.headline: Four Countries Will Share the 2031 Women's World Cup

네 나라가 이 대회를 함께 여는 것은 처음입니다. 미국이 마지막으로 대회를 연 것은 2003년입니다. 다음 대회는 2027년 브라질에서 열립니다. 그다음 2035년에는 영국이 개최합니다.

정리하면, 2031년 여자 월드컵은 역대 가장 큰 규모로 네 나라에서 열립니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Four Countries Will Share the 2031 Women's World Cup
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Imagine a World Cup so big that one country is not enough. That is exactly what is coming in 2031!

On Monday, November 23, FIFA confirmed the hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup. FIFA is the organization that runs world soccer. The tournament will be shared by four countries: the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica. News reports say the games will be spread across twenty cities. Fourteen are in the United States and four are in Mexico. On the same day, FIFA also approved the United Kingdom as the host for 2035.
Did you know? The United States won the very first Women's World Cup, held in China in 1991.
Why is this interesting? Women's soccer keeps growing, and a bigger tournament gives more teams a chance to play on the world stage.
To sum up, the 2031 Women's World Cup will be the biggest yet, with forty-eight teams in four countries.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.
한 나라로는 부족할 만큼 큰 월드컵을 상상해 보세요. 바로 그 대회가 2031년에 찾아옵니다!

11월 23일 월요일, FIFA가 2031년 여자 월드컵 개최국을 확정했습니다. FIFA는 세계 축구를 운영하는 기구입니다. 대회는 미국, 멕시코, 코스타리카, 자메이카 네 나라가 함께 엽니다. AP 통신에 따르면 이 계획은 FIFA 회원국들의 온라인 회의에서 승인되었습니다. 경쟁 유치 신청은 없었는데, 이는 다른 나라가 이 대회를 두고 경쟁하지 않았다는 뜻입니다.
이번 대회는 역대 가장 큰 여자 월드컵이 됩니다. 처음으로 48개 팀이 참가하고, 팬들은 104경기를 즐길 수 있습니다. 보도에 따르면 경기는 20개 도시에 나뉘어 열립니다. 14곳은 미국, 4곳은 멕시코에 있습니다. 코스타리카의 수도 산호세와 자메이카의 수도 킹스턴에서도 경기가 열립니다.
네 나라가 여자 월드컵을 공동 개최하는 것도 처음입니다. 공동 개최란 함께 행사를 여는 것을 말합니다. 미국은 1999년과 2003년 두 차례 여자 월드컵을 개최했습니다. 2031년에 앞서 2027년 대회는 브라질에서 32개 팀으로 열립니다. 같은 날 FIFA는 2035년 개최국으로 영국도 승인했습니다.
알고 계셨나요? 미국은 1991년 중국에서 열린 첫 여자 월드컵에서 우승했습니다.
왜 흥미로울까요? 여자 축구는 계속 성장하고 있고, 더 큰 대회는 더 많은 팀에게 세계 무대에서 뛸 기회를 줍니다.

들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

4.headline: US, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica to Co-Host 2031 Women's World Cup
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
For the first time, a Women's World Cup will be spread across four countries, and it will be the biggest one ever.

FIFA confirmed on Monday, November 23, that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will jointly host the 2031 Women's World Cup. According to the Associated Press, the joint bid was approved by acclamation in an online meeting of FIFA's 211 member federations, following a presentation at the organization's headquarters in Zurich. The bid faced no competition.

The 2031 edition will mark a major expansion. It will be the first women's tournament to feature forty-eight teams and one hundred and four matches. Reports say games will be staged in twenty cities, including fourteen in the United States and four in Mexico, along with San José in Costa Rica and Kingston in Jamaica.

The United States, which led the bid, previously hosted the competition on its own in 1999 and 2003. In the meantime, Brazil will stage the next tournament in 2027, with thirty-two teams. That means the 2031 tournament will welcome sixteen more teams than the one in Brazil. FIFA also ratified a bid from the United Kingdom, fronted by England, to host the 2035 edition.
Did you know? The American women lifted the very first Women's World Cup trophy, in China in 1991.

The decision reflects the rapid growth of the women's game. A larger field gives more national teams a shot at the global stage, while spreading matches across several countries could bring the sport to new audiences. Host cities may also see a welcome boost in visitors as supporters travel from one venue to the next.
To sum up, the 2031 Women's World Cup will be the largest in history, co-hosted by four nations across North America and the Caribbean.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
처음으로 여자 월드컵이 네 나라에 걸쳐 열리며, 역대 최대 규모가 됩니다.
FIFA는 11월 23일 월요일, 미국, 멕시코, 코스타리카, 자메이카가 2031년 여자 월드컵을 공동 개최한다고 확정했습니다. AP 통신에 따르면 이 공동 유치 신청은 취리히 본부에서 발표가 있은 뒤 FIFA 211개 회원 협회의 온라인 회의에서 만장 박수로 승인되었습니다. 경쟁 신청은 없었습니다.
2031년 대회는 크게 확대됩니다. 여자 대회 최초로 48개 팀과 104경기로 치러집니다. 보도에 따르면 경기는 미국 14곳, 멕시코 4곳, 그리고 코스타리카 산호세와 자메이카 킹스턴을 포함한 20개 도시에서 열립니다.
유치를 이끈 미국은 앞서 1999년과 2003년에 단독으로 대회를 개최했습니다. 그 사이 다음 대회는 2027년 브라질에서 32개 팀으로 열립니다. 즉 2031년 대회에는 브라질 대회보다 16개 팀이 더 참가하게 됩니다. FIFA는 잉글랜드가 주도한 영국의 2035년 대회 유치 신청도 승인했습니다.

이번 결정은 여자 축구의 빠른 성장을 보여 줍니다. 출전 팀이 늘면 더 많은 대표팀이 세계 무대에 설 기회를 얻고, 여러 나라에서 경기를 나눠 열면 새로운 관중에게 축구를 알릴 수 있습니다. 응원단이 경기장을 옮겨 다니면서 개최 도시들은 방문객 증가라는 반가운 효과도 볼 수 있습니다.
정리하면, 2031년 여자 월드컵은 북미와 카리브해의 네 나라가 공동 개최하는 역대 최대 규모 대회가 됩니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

5.headline: FIFA Hands 2031 Women's World Cup to Four-Nation Bid
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
Women's soccer is going supersized: the 2031 World Cup will stretch across four countries and feature more teams than ever before.

FIFA confirmed on Monday, November 23, that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup. The United States, which spearheaded the bid, is no stranger to the event, having staged it single-handedly in 1999 and again in 2003. Before then, Brazil will play host in 2027 to a thirty-two-team tournament, and FIFA has also rubber-stamped a United Kingdom bid, fronted by England, for 2035. Put simply, the jump from thirty-two to forty-eight teams means sixteen more nations will get a ticket to the party in 2031, a sizable leap for a competition that began with just twelve teams.
Did you know? The American women claimed the inaugural Women's World Cup, played in China back in 1991.

Beyond the headline numbers, the decision speaks to the women's game's remarkable momentum. An expanded field opens the door for more national teams to test themselves on the biggest stage, while a multi-country format could help win over fresh audiences across the region. For the host cities, there is a commercial upside too, as traveling supporters fill hotels, restaurants and stadiums from Mexico to the Caribbean.
To sum up, the 2031 Women's World Cup is shaping up to be the most ambitious yet, with forty-eight teams and four co-hosts spanning North America and the Caribbean.

1.headline: Korea's Education Minister Quits After Exam Trouble
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Korea's top education leader has quit his job.
His name is Choi Kyo-jin. He was the education minister. A minister is a leader in the government. He quit on Sunday.

Why? It is about the Suneung. This is the big test for college. People worried about cheating with AI. So the government made new rules just before the test. Phones got loud alerts to find hidden phones. Many people felt confused.
Choi said sorry. He said his team was not ready. The president said yes to his leaving.
Officials found one hundred and eleven students with smart devices.
Again, the education minister quit after the test trouble.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.

2.headline: Korea's Education Minister Steps Down Over Exam Confusion
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Can a few phone alerts cost a minister his job? In Korea, it seems they can.
Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin stepped down on Sunday, November 22. He said he would take responsibility for confusion around this year's Suneung. The Suneung is Korea's big college entrance exam.

The trouble began just before the exam. A top scorer on a national tax accountant test admitted cheating with AI. Many people then worried about AI cheating on the Suneung. So the government added new rules at the last minute. For example, it sent surprise emergency alerts to phones. The goal was to find hidden smartphones. But the changes confused students and parents.

Choi said his ministry was not ready. President Lee Jae Myung accepted his resignation within an hour. Officials say one hundred and eleven test-takers were caught with smart devices. Penalties will be decided before scores come out on December 11.
To sum up, the education minister resigned after last-minute exam rules caused confusion.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어 아침 뉴스입니다.
휴대폰 경보 몇 번 때문에 장관이 자리를 잃을 수 있을까요? 한국에서는 그런 것 같습니다.
최교진 교육부 장관이 11월 22일 일요일에 물러났습니다. 그는 올해 수능을 둘러싼 혼란에 책임을 지겠다고 말했습니다. 수능은 한국의 큰 대학 입학시험입니다.

문제는 시험 직전에 시작됐습니다. 국가 세무사 시험의 수석 합격자가 AI로 부정행위를 했다고 인정했습니다. 그러자 많은 사람이 수능에서의 AI 부정행위를 걱정했습니다. 그래서 정부는 마지막 순간에 새 규칙을 추가했습니다. 예를 들어 휴대폰에 예고 없는 긴급 경보를 보냈습니다. 숨긴 스마트폰을 찾기 위해서였습니다. 하지만 이런 변화는 학생과 학부모를 혼란스럽게 했습니다.
최 장관은 교육부가 준비되지 않았다고 말했습니다. 이재명 대통령은 한 시간도 안 되어 그의 사표를 수리했습니다. 당국에 따르면 수험생 111명이 스마트 기기를 가지고 있다가 적발됐습니다. 처벌은 12월 11일 성적 발표 전에 결정됩니다.
정리하면, 교육부 장관이 막판 시험 규칙이 혼란을 일으킨 뒤 사퇴했습니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Korea's Education Minister Steps Down Over Suneung Confusion
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Can a few surprise phone alerts end a minister's career? In South Korea this week, they helped do just that.

Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin offered his resignation on Sunday, November 22. Resignation means officially leaving your job. Choi said he would take responsibility for the confusion caused by last-minute changes to this year's Suneung. The Suneung is the national college entrance exam, and it is one of the most important days in a Korean student's life.

According to the Korea Herald, the problem started just before the exam. The top scorer on a national tax accountant exam admitted to cheating with the help of AI. This raised fears that students could also use AI to cheat on the Suneung. So the government quickly added extra measures. A measure is a step or action to deal with a problem. One of them was an unscheduled emergency alert sent to phones, to catch hidden smartphones in exam rooms. Many people said the sudden changes were confusing.

In a statement, Choi said the ministry could not escape criticism that it was not prepared in advance. President Lee Jae Myung accepted his resignation about an hour later, and the process to choose a new minister will begin. Officials say one hundred and eleven test-takers were caught with smart devices, including smart glasses. Penalties will be decided before scores are released on December 11.
Why does this matter? The Suneung shapes young people's futures, so fairness is a very big issue. The case also shows how AI is creating new challenges for schools and exams.
To sum up, Korea's education minister stepped down after last-minute anti-cheating rules caused confusion around the Suneung.
Thank you for listening.

4.headline: Education Minister Resigns Amid Suneung Controversy
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
South Korea's education minister has resigned, saying he could not escape blame for the confusion surrounding this year's college entrance exam.

Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin tendered his resignation on Sunday, November 22, saying he would take responsibility for the turmoil caused by last-minute changes designed to prevent AI-assisted cheating on the College Scholastic Ability Test, better known as the Suneung. According to the Korea Herald, President Lee Jae Myung accepted the resignation roughly an hour after it was submitted, and the presidential office said the process of appointing a successor would begin.

The controversy traces back to a case that came to light shortly before the exam, when the top scorer on the national tax accountant certification exam admitted to cheating with the help of AI. That revelation fueled concerns that test-takers might try the same on the Suneung, prompting the government to roll out additional safeguards. Among them were unscheduled emergency alerts sent to phones to expose devices hidden in exam rooms, a step widely criticized as disruptive.

In a statement released by the ministry, Choi acknowledged the inconvenience to students and the public and said the ministry could not avoid criticism that it had failed to prepare in advance. Officials say one hundred and eleven test-takers were caught with smart devices, including smart glasses and a miniature camera. A ministry committee will decide on penalties before scores are released on December 11, and the government and the ruling Democratic Party have proposed extending the ban on AI cheaters to ten years.
The episode highlights how quickly AI tools are testing the integrity of high-stakes exams.
To sum up, Korea's education minister has stepped down over the handling of AI cheating fears around the Suneung.
Thank you for listening.

5.headline: Korea's Education Chief Falls on His Sword Over Suneung Chaos
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
A cheating scandal at a professional licensing exam has claimed an unlikely casualty: South Korea's education minister.

Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin offered his resignation on Sunday, November 22, saying he would shoulder responsibility for the disarray triggered by eleventh-hour measures meant to stamp out AI-assisted cheating on the College Scholastic Ability Test, the high-stakes university entrance exam universally known as the Suneung. As the Korea Herald reported, President Lee Jae Myung accepted the resignation within roughly an hour, and the presidential office said the search for a successor would get under way.

The chain of events began shortly before exam day, when the top scorer on the national tax accountant certification exam confessed to having cheated with the help of artificial intelligence. The admission sent alarm bells ringing about the Suneung, and the government scrambled to bolt on additional safeguards. Chief among them were unannounced emergency alerts pushed to mobile phones, intended to flush out devices smuggled into exam halls, a tactic that drew widespread criticism for adding to the anxiety on an already nerve-racking day.

In a statement released through the ministry, Choi conceded that the flurry of changes had inconvenienced test-takers and the public, and said that, as minister, he could not escape the charge that the ministry had been caught unprepared. Officials say one hundred and eleven candidates were caught with smart devices, among them smart glasses and a miniature camera paired with wireless earphones. A ministry committee is weighing penalties ahead of the release of scores on December 11, while the government and the ruling Democratic Party have floated a ten-year ban for AI cheaters, one that could even apply retroactively to this year's exam. Authorities are also mulling a review of past exams in response to credible tips, and exam papers must now be kept at test sites for at least a year.
The affair underscores a dilemma confronting education systems everywhere: generative AI is evolving faster than the rules designed to keep exams fair.
To sum up, Korea's education minister has fallen on his sword over the botched rollout of anti-cheating measures surrounding the Suneung.
Thank you for listening.
